## Pull request overview

This PR focuses on stabilizing the docs site by fixing missing schema context in interactive demos, hardening several renderers against non-array `.map()` crashes during SSG, and adding Playwright smoke coverage for key documentation pages.

**Changes:**
- Wrap `InteractiveDemo`’s rendered schemas in a minimal `SchemaRendererContext.Provider` to prevent plugin pages from crashing due to missing context.
- Add `Array.isArray` guards in multiple renderers to prevent SSG prerender `.map is not a function` runtime errors.
- Add Playwright docs smoke tests covering representative docs routes and basic “no JS errors / no overlay / no 404 assets” checks.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/site/app/components/InteractiveDemo.tsx | Adds a minimal `SchemaRendererContext` provider around demos so plugin components can resolve context. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/resizable.tsx | Guards `schema.panels` with `Array.isArray` before mapping. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/list.tsx | Guards list `items` source with `Array.isArray` to avoid `.map()` crashes. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/tree-view.tsx | Guards tree `nodes` source with `Array.isArray` to avoid `.map()` crashes. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/table.tsx | Guards `columns` source with `Array.isArray` to avoid `.map()` crashes. |
| e2e/docs-smoke.spec.ts | Adds Playwright smoke tests for key docs pages and asset loading. |
</details>

`ResizablePanel` keys currently use the array index. The `ResizablePanel` type includes a required `id` field, so using `panel.id` would provide stable keys and avoid React reconciliation issues when panels are reordered/inserted.
```suggestion
          <React.Fragment key={panel.id ?? index}>
```

These tests default to `DOCS_BASE_URL` = `http://localhost:3000`, but the repo’s `playwright.config.ts` webServer currently builds/serves the console app on `http://localhost:4173`. As-is, `pnpm test:e2e` will fail unless a separate docs server is started manually. Consider skipping this spec when `DOCS_BASE_URL` isn’t explicitly set, or add a dedicated Playwright config/project with its own `webServer` that builds & serves `apps/site`.

`defaultCtx` sets `dataSource: {}`. Because `useDataScope()` returns `dataSource` when `schema.bind` is undefined, a truthy object here can override inline demo data (e.g., tables/tree views) and lead to empty renders or incorrect errors. Prefer `dataSource: null` (or a well-defined noop/mock DataSource) so components without `bind` fall back to their inline `schema.*` data, while plugins can still find the context provider.

`rawNodes` is computed with `boundData || ...`, but `useDataScope(schema.bind)` returns the entire `dataSource` when `schema.bind` is undefined. If the context `dataSource` is a truthy non-array object, this will ignore `schema.nodes/schema.data` and render an empty tree. Consider only preferring `boundData` when it’s an array (or when `schema.bind` is set), e.g. fall back to `schema.nodes/schema.data` when `boundData` isn’t an array.
```suggestion
    const rawNodes = Array.isArray(boundData) ? boundData : schema.nodes || schema.data || [];
```
